steps.label: Close the inlet valve
steps.hint: Isolate upstream first so the line stops filling behind you.

steps.label: Close the outlet valve
steps.hint: Now close downstream to trap the section between both valves.

steps.label: Bleed the trapped line
steps.hint: Open the drain under the pipe to release pressure before anyone works on it.

steps.label: Hang the lockout tag
steps.hint: Tag the isolation so nobody reopens it while the work is going on.
